title: 心理学データ解析基礎
subtitle: Elements of Psychological Data Analysis
keywords: Spreadsheet 2.Data processing 3.Functions 4.Basic statistics 5.Creating figures and tables
educationalGoal: Through practical training using spreadsheet software (Excel) students will: ・ Be able to understand data processing and chart creation. ・ Be able to understand how to use functions. ・ Be able to understand basic statistics.
advice: The data analysis courses of the Department of Psychological Science aim to teach the knowledge and skills necessary to analyze data obtained from psychological experiments. In particular, this course will teach students about data processing using the spreadsheet software Excel. The course is conducted with lectures and practical training. In order to spend as much time as possible on the practical training, students are required to prepare for the class, and they are required to understand the contents through preparation and to confirm their understanding through practical training during the course. If students do not understand the information during class time, they should deal with it as soon as possible by using office hours. This course will focus on the following topics: 1. Spreadsheet software (Excel) basic technology: data processing, creating figures and tables 2. How to use Excel functions 3. Concepts of basic statistics: mean, median, mode, maximum, minimum, variance, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis * Be sure to bring a computer to each class as you will be using the spreadsheet software (Excel)
requiredKnowledge: Students must to bring a personal computer to each class to do the practical training every week. There are many opportunities to use data analysis in psychology, so students should look for solutions with an awareness of the problem.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will be able to understand the basic operations of spreadsheet software (Excel). Furthermore, they will be able to select and use basic statistics using functions. Students will be able to create figures and tables suitable for the information that they would like to express.
achievementLevels.standard: Students will be able to understand the basic operations of spreadsheet software (Excel) and calculate basic statistics using functions. Students will be able to create figures and tables for use in psychological experiment reports.
